final: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate as net_rate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND f.rebrate IS NOT NULL), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(net_rate) as bench FROM matched), pair_stats AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_rate) as pair_avg FROM matched GROUP BY mktnote) SELECT AVG(pair_avg) as avg_of_pair_avgs, AVG(pair_avg - (SELECT bench FROM benchmark)) as avg_excess FROM pair_stats WHERE pair_avg > (SELECT bench FROM benchmark)
